description.value: A community bike shop on the UBC campus run by the Alma Mater Society, offering both professional repairs and a hands-on DIY tool share where visiting cyclists can fix their own bikes with mechanic guidance. They stock a mix of new and used components and sell refurbished bicycles. The shop also runs community programs including bike mechanics workshops, access nights for marginalized groups, and a kids' bike library.

address.value: 6138 Student Union Boulevard, Unit 36, Vancouver, BC V6T 1Z1

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 47m; stands (20 spaces, covered) at 67m; stands (27 spaces) at 100m. Total: 57 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms UBC Bike Kitchen is an active community bike shop with professional mechanics, DIY repair stands, and free tire inflation. OSM tag service:bicycle:pump=yes is corroborated by the website stating 'Inflating tires and oiling chains is free to do.' The service shop page explicitly states they decline electronic shifting, computer systems, power meters, scooters, and electric scooters, which constitutes negative evidence for e-bike service. Phone (604-827-7333), address (6138 Student Union Blvd, Room 36), and website URL all match between OSM and the site.
concerns: University-affiliated (AMS-operated) — may have reduced availability during UBC breaks or summer sessions
Website still references COVID-19 suspensions of some programming, which may be outdated
As of April 2022 the shop no longer provides bike storage
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active community bike shop with professional mechanics, DIY repair stands, free tire inflation, and parts sales. Highly useful for touring cyclists passing through Vancouver's west side.

Staff help with urgent mechanical issues.detail: 'Walk-in repairs are welcome, repair schedule permitting' + free drop-in assessments 'we do our best to do them on the spot'

DIY stand.detail: 4 repair stands available with an extensive collection of tools; expert mechanics on hand to assist; closed-toe shoes required
